apps.name: DS Bot
apps.subtitle: Your Bot team, from your phone
apps.localizedDescription: Controls the DS Bot team that runs on your computer, through an end-to-end encrypted link. Pair it in DS Bot under Settings → Phone.

versions.localizedDescription: New iOS 26 icon with dark and tinted styles.
First SideStore build: pair with DS Bot under Settings → Phone. System navigation and controls on iOS.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DS Bot sends the photos you choose to your Bots, and uses one you choose as a Bot avatar.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: DS Bot uses the camera to scan the pairing code that your computer shows.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: DS Bot asks for Face ID before it changes keys, secrets, connectors or updates on your computer.
